create_MCPTool: create an MCPTool with name, description, input_schema, and handler for registering callable tools
build_ToolSchema: build a ToolSchema with name, description, and inputSchema for listing available tools
create_ListToolsResponse: create a ListToolsResponse containing a list of ToolSchema objects with optional pagination cursor
build_CallToolRequest: build a CallToolRequest with method and params for invoking a registered tool by name
create_ContentItem: create a ContentItem with type and optional text for structuring tool call response content
